# prismasdwan_vrf_context_profile (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Vrf Context Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "vrf_context_profile".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_vrf_context_profile" "example" {
  default_vrf_context_profile = false
  description                 = "Managed by Terraform"
  name                        = "example_name"
  tags                        = ["terraform"]
  vrf_context_ids             = ["<vrf_context_id>"]
  vrf_context_route_leak_rules = [{
    description         = "Managed by Terraform"
    dest_vrf_context_id = "<dest_vrf_context_id>"
    ipv4_prefixes       = ["10.10.0.0/16"]
    name                = "example_name"
    src_vrf_context_id  = "<src_vrf_context_id>"
  }]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `default_vrf_context_profile` (Boolean) Default vrf context profile.
- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: length 1 to 128 characters, matching `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\s-]*$`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 1024 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `vrf_context_ids` (Set of String) Vrf context ids.
- `vrf_context_route_leak_rules` (Attributes List) Vrf context route leak rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrf_context_route_leak_rules))
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
